start: if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo sh /tmp/get-docker.sh && rm /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER || true; fi && if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi && (sudo systemctl start docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo service docker start >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && timeout 45 bash -lc 'until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' || (echo 'docker_unavailable' >&2; true)

terminals.name: PostgreSQL Database
terminals.command: bun run db:start && echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready...' && timeout 60 bash -c 'until docker exec alfred-postgres pg_isready -U alfred > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && echo 'PostgreSQL is ready!'
